<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex050192026-08-2504-42-52" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="">dge ba'i bshes gnyen lha spyil ba 'od zer bla ma</rs> la | <rs type="work">'grel chung</rs> gi smad cig | 
               <lb edRef="inst:4881" n="5b3"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3874">mchad kha ba</rs>'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4524">grub mtha'</rs> : <rs type="work">shes rab rnying po'i 'grel pa</rs> 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3735">slob dpon ka ma la shi la </rs>dang <rs type="person" ana="">pad ma 'byung gnas</rs> kyi mdzad pa | ltung bshags kyi 'grel slon dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa | mgon
               <lb edRef="inst:4881" n="5b4"/> po | rab gnas | sgo drug gzungs kyi cho ga | shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi mchod pa'i cho ga | brda'i ti ka | blo sbyong rgyas pa | dus mchod kyi gtor ma
               <lb edRef="inst:4881" n="5b5"/> mdzad lugs lasogs pa dang | rgyal po gzugs can rnying po la gdams pa'i mdo lasogs pa mdo chung mang po dang | chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i rgyu lasogs pa bstan bcos mang po dang |
               <lb edRef="inst:4881" n="5b6"/>rnam thar rtsa 'grel bzhi lasogs pa gsan |</seg></TEI>
